name: discover_airtable_schema_context
description: Discovers all configured Airtable bases, tables, fields, field types, select choices, and linked-table relations. Stores a schema snapshot for PI so it can suggest updateable fields even when the user does not explicitly mention the field name.

payload.refresh: boolean (Optional. If true, force a fresh metadata read from Airtable instead of relying on cached schema context.)
payload.base_labels: array of strings (Optional. Restrict discovery to configured bases such as 'main', 'trips', or 'religious'.)
payload.target_table: string (Optional. Restrict discovery output to a specific Airtable table name such as 'List' or 'Leads CRM'.)
payload.include_field_options: boolean (Optional. If true, include select/multi-select choices where available.)
payload.max_fields_per_table: integer (Optional. Limits returned fields per table in the action result while still saving the full snapshot.)
